slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Handheld shooting adds energy and realism.
It matters because it creates an immersive, human feel.
Use controlled micro-movements, stable posture, and intentional motion.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: Use controlled micro-movements, stable posture, and intentional motion.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Use your body as a shock absorber.
Add subtle motion to avoid static shake.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use a wider lens to hide micro‑shake.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Over‑shaking the camera and calling it "handheld style."
